checked_mathematics.assessment: H(x)=cos(2pi x)/(1-16x²), F(x)=H(x/.9); source norm equals Si(pi)/2 and leakage equals1-sin(.45pi), hence J=(4sin(.45pi)-3)/(.45Si(pi)); matches cmsJ exactly.

Taylor order14 absolute remainder after division by x yields x^13/14!; the integrated remainder coefficient is pi^14/(14*14!). Sinc is sin(x)/x, so the source normalization matches. Positive integral and denominator are proved. Rational lower1.1405 is valid and slack.

Source(6.16) retains RH, source no-prime assumption, lambda=.9, .5<=c<=1 and x>=4e18; L>=44 is inside that source domain. Proposed SourceCMS616 is an adapted explicit B premise, not a theorem proved from the old Green/Nicolas/BPT package.

t=log(1+c L exp(-L/2))/2 and a=exp(L+t) give a exp(-t)=expL and a exp(t)=expL+c sqrt(expL)L. mainScale=sqrt(a)t; logScale=log(1/t). Source closed-no-prime implication is safe even if its proof first uses a half-open interval.
